info.title: VisiConvert public API
info.description: Workspace-scoped API for hosted and self-hosted integrations. Bearer keys are created in the workspace API keys screen. Keys cannot administer credentials, billing, or keys. Hosted requests fail closed when Rails access verification is unavailable. /leads aliases /interactions. Lists of inquiries, interactions and bookings use keyset pagination; numbers and source reports return arrays. No automatic request retries.

purchased.description: Bought through VisiConvert, so it can be released here.

release_requested_at.description: Set during the release hold; the number still forwards calls until released.

InquiryDetail.description: Inquiry, original interactions and latest 100 history entries; qualification/notes/version are shared by the inquiry.

TwilioStatus.description: Connection status, revision and callback URLs. Never includes provider secrets.

request_id.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Retrying the same request never buys twice; a failed request needs a new ID.

managed.description: The project is provisioned and billed by VisiConvert Cloud.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin without path, query, fragment or wildcard; HTTP only for localhost.

version.description: 0 for creation; current list_sites version for updates. Stale updates return 409.

Site.description: Website settings and historical session_count, form_count, last_session_at and last_form_at. Browser-reported activity is not proof of authenticity.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin without path, query, fragment or wildcard; HTTP only for localhost.

version.description: 0 for creation; current list_sites version for updates. Stale updates return 409.

fallback_phone.description: Published US E.164 website number to replace and retain as fallback. Keep outside all pools.

destination_phone.description: US E.164 forwarding destination shared by every pool number. Must not be a registered tracking number. If omitted, preserve the existing destination; a new pool defaults to fallback_phone.

version.description: 0 for absent pool; current pool version for updates.

dedicated_numbers.description: Explicit acknowledgement required to enable a pool.

Pool.description: Pool configuration (null if absent), available numbers and last 50 assignments. Use pool.version for updates; removed numbers revoke assignments.

Setup.description: Historical setup evidence, not a live health guarantee. Sites include pool configuration and last assignment; numbers include call_count and last_call_at. No contact fields or provider credentials. get_status/connection endpoints separately report provider readiness.

url.description: HTTPS URL on port 443 with a public hostname. Self-hosted operators can allow private addresses and HTTP with VISICONVERT_WEBHOOKS_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true.

include_contact.description: Include name, contact, notes and submitted form fields. When false, fetch them through the API.

state.description: Updates only. Setting enabled re-enables a disabled endpoint.

version.description: 0 for creation; the current version for updates. Stale updates return 409.

Webhook.description: Endpoint settings. The signing secret is never returned after creation or rotation.

secret_rotating_until.description: Until this time requests carry signatures from both the previous and current secret.

WebhookWithSecret.description: Endpoint and its whsec_ signing secret, shown once.

secret_rotating_until.description: Until this time requests carry signatures from both the previous and current secret.

secret.description: Standard Webhooks secret. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

key.description: Fixed after creation; must match the path.

google_action_id.description: An existing eligible Google import action (preferred), or null.

version.description: 0 to create, otherwise the current version.

ConversionAction.description: A pipeline conversion action with its Google mapping, version and timestamps.

login.description: Google Ads access account (login customer ID).

ConversionSetup.description: Pipeline setup checklist. next_steps items have actor (agent, owner_approval, owner or administrator) and step. owner_approval steps (advertising account, inferred calls, Google delivery, automatic sending) can be done with a conversions:send key once the owner confirms. Owner steps (connect Google) cannot be done with a key. The checklist includes connection_revision and settings_version for POST /conversion-setup/check. Items with advisory true come from the last Google Ads review (google_review) and never block ready. microsoft holds the Microsoft Advertising section with its own ready, next_steps, summary, connection_revision and destination_version; it never changes the Google fields.

version.description: settings_version from GET /conversion-setup (0 if none saved)

customer_id.description: Advertising account reachable from the connected login that owns its conversion tracking

allow_inferred_calls.description: Send calls matched to a website visit by timing on a DNI number

qualified_action_id.description: Reviewed flow; omitted keeps the saved value for the same account, required when changing accounts ("" clears)

booking_action_id.description: Reviewed flow; same rules as qualified_action_id

GoogleDestination.description: Saved destination (customer_id, account_name, login, qualified_action_id, booking_action_id, allow_inferred_calls, version) and the setup checklist.

login.description: Google Ads access account from GET /connections/google/accounts

GoogleReview.description: Every non-removed conversion action in the saved Google Ads account: id, name, type, category, origin, status, primary_for_goal, counting, click_window_days, default_value, currency, always_use_default_value, owner, conversions_30d, conversions_90d (all_conversions) and last_conversion_date, plus goal {category, origin, biddable} (the account-level customer conversion goal it belongs to, or null), goal_shared_with (names of the other actions in that goal), bidding (primary_for_goal and a biddable goal: whether Smart Bidding optimizes toward it), mapped (VisiConvert sends to it), note, and flags. The bidding flags (dead_upload, call_overlap, and active_other_uploader as a warning) use bidding, not primary_for_goal alone. Each flag has code (mapped, active_other_uploader, dead_upload, call_overlap), severity (info or warning), a plain-language explanation and a suggestion. warnings lists the actions with warning flags; summary says it in one sentence; has_more is true past 200 actions.

primary.description: true makes the action primary (counts toward goals and bidding); false makes it secondary (reported only).

login.description: Google Ads access account; defaults to the last checked one

GoogleGoalChange.description: customer_id, login, summary, warnings, has_more and reviewed_at from the refreshed review, plus changed and either action (the changed action, from the action goal route) or goal {category, origin, biddable, resource_name} and actions (every action in that goal, from the goal route).

biddable.description: false stops Smart Bidding optimizing toward this goal across the account

login.description: Google Ads access account; defaults to the last checked one

DestinationCheck.description: The same report the owner route returns: valid, pipeline_actions_valid, login_customer_id, account, actions, settings_version, uploads_enabled and message.

attested_by.description: The owner the attestation is recorded for. A key or MCP connection attests on behalf of the owner who created it.

warning.description: Present while automatic sending is on: turn off every other uploader for the same Google actions to avoid double counting.

version.description: Current version from GET /conversion-delivery; a stale version returns 409.

auto_send.description: Send eligible pipeline events automatically. Events recorded while it was off are never sent.

attest_no_eea_advertising.description: Required true when setting not_required_outside_eea, and allowed only then: the owner confirms this workspace does not advertise to people in the EEA, UK or Switzerland.

GoogleDiscovery.description: Google Ads discovery for the connected login.

action.description: Key of an events-triggered conversion action defined in Conversions.

external_id.description: Your ID for this event. Reposting it with a different value or time creates the next revision; an identical repost is a no-op.

phone.description: Matches the last 10 digits of a call or form contact.

email.description: Matches a form contact, trimmed and case-insensitive.

attribution.description: For match: the earliest (acquisition) or most recent lead with a Google click.

value_minor.description: Integer cents. Defaults to the action default on creation; omitted on a repost keeps the current value.

occurred_at.description: Defaults to now on creation; not in the future.

google.description: pending: waiting for the worker; queued: frozen and waiting to send; sent: Google accepted the request; delivered: Google processed it; blocked: not sent, see reason.

microsoft.description: Microsoft Advertising status, or null when the event was never planned for Microsoft: status (pending, queued, delivered, retracted, blocked, failed, uncertain, canceled), reason, delivery_id, delivery_state, kind (upload, restate, retract), delivery_revision and tracking_id.

destination_version.description: microsoft.destination_version from GET /conversion-setup (0 before the first choice)

account_id.description: Ad account ID from GET /connections/microsoft/accounts, reachable by the connected Microsoft user

MicrosoftDestination.description: The chosen ad account (id, name, number, customer_id, status, currency), the new destination_version and the setup checklist.

MicrosoftCheck.description: valid, account {id, name, number, status, currency, customer_id}, goals (every offline conversion goal: id, name, status, count_type, window_minutes, scope, category, revenue_type, kind, exclude_from_bidding, eligible), mapped (per enabled mapped action: action, goal_name, found, eligible, accepts_uploads_after), destination_version and message.

MicrosoftReview.description: Every web and offline conversion goal in the saved ad account: id, name, type, status, category, count_type, window_minutes, exclude_from_bidding, used_by (VisiConvert actions that send to it) and flags (other_offline_goal, website_goal_same_category, mapped_goal_not_accepting, count_type_differs, short_window); warnings, summary and flag explanations. Read-only.

goal_name.description: Exact name of an offline conversion goal in the saved ad account, or null to clear. A new or changed mapping applies only to events recorded from now on.

include_since.description: Owner-confirmed: also send events and Microsoft-click leads since this time, at most 90 days ago. Only for clicks no other uploader sent, or Microsoft counts them twice. Requires goal_name.

category.description: Defaults to SubmitLeadForm for once_per_click and Purchase for every

MicrosoftGoalCreated.description: action (the mapped action), goal {id, name}, created, accepts_uploads_after (Microsoft accepts uploads about 2 hours after creation) and notes.

MicrosoftDiscovery.description: Microsoft Advertising discovery for the connected user: accounts and has_more, or account and goals.

status.description: Call status, received, recorded, revised, blocked, canceled, delivery state, or the last HTTP status of a webhook delivery

detail.description: Safe per-source fields such as contact, tracking number, attempts, diagnostic or HTTP status. Never payloads, click IDs, provider requests or secrets.

external_id.description: Your stable ID for the chat, for example visicomms-chat:1234

started_at.description: When the visitor started the chat; within the last 90 days

landing_url.description: The page the visitor landed on, with its query string; must be on one of the workspace's enabled sites (www and the bare host count as one)

click.description: Click IDs the landing URL lacks; a value that differs from the URL's is refused

phone.description: 10 to 15 digits; the last 10 are used for matching

created.description: False when the external_id was already recorded

click.description: Whether the chat's visit carries an ad click ID

visit.description: On creation: whether the tracker's recorded visit was found or one was built from landing_url

post.summary: Record a web chat lead with the ad click from its landing page, or add the visitor's name, phone or email to one already recorded
post.description: Requires `leads:write` permission. The chat is linked to the website visit the tracker recorded with the same gclid, msclkid or fbclid, or to a visit built from `landing_url`, and then counts like a form lead for pipeline delivery and `new_lead` actions. Posting the same `external_id` again only adds or replaces `name`, `phone` and `email`; the click, site and time never change.
